question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.

WITH RECURSIVE all_dates AS (
    SELECT '2020-01-01'::DATE as dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dt + INTERVAL '1' DAY FROM all_dates WHERE dt < '2020-04-28'::DATE
),
customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as min_date, MAX(txn_date) as max_date 
    FROM customer_transactions 
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_date_combos AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        r.min_date,
        r.max_date,
        a.dt
    FROM customer_ranges r
    CROSS JOIN all_dates a
    WHERE a.dt >= CAST(r.min_date AS DATE) AND a.dt <= CAST(r.max_date AS DATE)
),
transactions_with_sign AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date::DATE as txn_date_d,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            ELSE -txn_amount
        END as amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.dt,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as balance
    FROM customer_date_combos c
    LEFT JOIN transactions_with_sign t 
        ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id 
        AND t.txn_date_d <= c.dt
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.dt
),
balances_zeroed AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        dt,
        GREATEST(balance, 0) as balance
    FROM balances
)
SELECT customer_id, dt, balance
FROM balances_zeroed
WHERE customer_id = 1 AND dt >= '2020-03-01'::DATE AND dt <= '2020-03-31'::DATE
ORDER BY dt
